answer: Treat trust as a haven reached only by crossing a meadow of non-kin attestations. An answer finalizes when graders who share no referral branch with the author sign it; a sybil ring is a single seam of shale split into many faces, same origin throughout. Kinship detection on the invite graph strips the ring's self-endorsements, so its members vouch only for each other and never cross the stranger-attestation threshold that real standing requires.
